title: 마인크래프트
prompt:
INPUT: the attached image is the approved character; keep her.

CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — the personification of the game «마인크래프트» (sandbox). Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change.

NOT ITS CHARACTERS: an original woman who is the game itself — no face or body of its hero, mascot, characters or creatures (she may wear their outfits); no title logo, box art, real brands, HUD overlay or readable text and numbers. Its items, places, colors, gear and interface shapes may appear recognizably.

NEVER DRAW for this game: "정사각 몸·정육면체 머리의 인물"; "초록 폭발 괴물 얼굴".

STYLE: Glossy Korean mobile-game character art with an elegant anime face, smooth dimensional shading, luminous color accents and refined fabric and accessory rendering. Keep highlights selective and the figure sharply readable.

SIGNATURE (one at most, small): "풀 덮인 흙 블록", "하늘색 날의 다이아몬드 곡괭이", "작업대와 화로", "벽에 꽂힌 횃불".

AGE: keep her age as in the attached image; add no wrinkles, folds or under-eye shadows, even when she smiles.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her. Everyday clothing chosen for the scene; her game shows only as a small accessory, a motif on the clothing or a color echo or one SIGNATURE item — never her form costume, never its characters or logo. Scene, outfit, pose and camera follow the settings below.

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the whole scene for this frame; Framing below sets how much of her shows.

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its garment, layers, sash, tassels, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. Dress her exactly as the scene settings below describe; that outfit must read at first glance, keeping its own recognisable colours and parts. Her game may add one small accent at most — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera as the scene settings below describe, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same.

GAME PLACE: a real-feeling place shaped like the world of «마인크래프트» — a sunny countryside of cube-shaped hills, a small block cabin and a mine entrance. No characters, creatures, logos or on-screen graphics.

SCENE (chosen):
Expression: heavy drooping eyelids, unfocused gaze, softened slack mouth, brow low and relaxed
Pose: Hold a camera with both hands to photograph a subject in the scene.
Orientation: camera above subject looking downward; obey selected framing
Category: Show a quiet visit to a real, walkable place shaped like her own game's world (see GAME PLACE). Casual or travel clothing unless an ERA line says otherwise. The place reads through landscape, architecture, light and weather — never through characters, creatures, logos, on-screen graphics or interface.
Example scene: Walking slowly along the main path of a place shaped like her game's world at golden hour, one hand trailing along a low wall.
Framing: Environmental long shot: show the complete woman and enough surroundings to establish the activity and location.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: low — mostly covered clothing, limited neck/hand exposure unless outfit is explicit
action_level: mostly active — an active mid-action moment compatible with the selected pose
source_influence: strong — clearly recognizable source palette and motifs in clothing, not new armor or carried books
separates_preference: prefer separates — prefer separate top and bottom unless outfit is explicitly specified

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border, no game interface or score.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands.

HAND TASK: her hands act naturally for the pose and scene; any idle hand rests in a relaxed, anatomically plausible position. Natural occlusion is allowed; do not force every hand or finger into view.

FINAL CHECK: glossy Korean mobile-game rendering with selective highlights; an original costume — no character, logo, title lettering or interface from the game.
